items.title: Mahomet Cub Scout Pack 25
items.text:
Cub Scout Pack 25 in Mahomet, Illinois was formed on November 30, 1947* and is chartered by the Mahomet-Seymour Parent Teacher Organization. We are a member of the Prairielands Council within Scouting America.

We welcome ALL youth in grades K-5 and meet regularly for fun, adventure, and learning — building character, citizenship, and confidence in youth.

items.title: General Info & Regular Events
items.text:
• Pack (large group) Meeting — Second Monday of every month, 6:30 PM @ Lincoln Trail Elementary
  • Den (small group) Meetings - Meet 1 Monday per month, see Calendar for specific dates
  • Swimming Adventure - August
  • Fall Campout at Camp Drake - great for beginners!
  • Popcorn Fundraiser — September/October
  • Bicycle Rodeo
  • Pinewood Derby - February (Make and Race your own car!)
  • Spring Campout at TBD (generally IL State Park)
  • and MUCH MORE!

For all events, see Calendar for specific details.

items.title: New Families / Questions?
items.text:
New Scouts are welcome to join at ANY time of year. Interested in joining or have questions? E-mail: mahometcubmaster@gmail.com
